culture-cycles.note: Holidays the community chose or set itself for 2027 (national holidays are on Spain's record). Local town holidays are not included.

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General
sources.supports: fourth-Sunday-of-May rule for local and regional elections (read directly); the 2027 date is calculated from it

laws.rule: In La Rioja forests and forest land, free camping is prohibited except in forms and areas established by regulation. Camping within 100 metres of springs and fountains is prohibited.
laws.heading: Ley 2/1995, artículo 76

laws.rule: In La Rioja forests, recreational fires are restricted to places designated for that purpose under the regulations. Check current fire-danger restrictions as well.
laws.heading: Ley 2/1995, artículo 76

laws.rule: In La Rioja forests, recreational and sporting motor activities off-road are prohibited except on circuits authorised by the regional authority.
laws.heading: Ley 2/1995, artículo 76

laws.rule: In La Rioja forests, visitors must collect and take away the waste they produce; actions that prevent or limit the normal behaviour of protected species are prohibited.
laws.heading: Ley 2/1995, artículo 76

sources.title: Ley 2/1995, artículo 76
sources.supports: Consolidated regional forest law, article 76 (read directly).
